name: Hello Notes
description: Minimal nd.extension/1 sample package. Copy this folder to start your own extension: one launcher command that saves a note, one schema-driven list view over the notes it creates, and one instruction-only skill. Every declared field is consumed by ND, and no executable is required.

commands.title: Save a hello note
commands.description: Save the launcher text as a note in the selected context.

views.title: Hello notes
views.description: No hello notes yet. Run Save a hello note from the launcher.

skills.title: Hello Notes walkthrough
skills.description: Instruction-only skill explaining the sample package. No code runs.
skills.instructions: Hello Notes is the minimal nd.extension/1 sample. It saves notes with note.create, lists them in a schema-driven view backed by note.search, and opens one with note.open. Explain that an ND extension declares data in nd-extension.json and never ships renderer code: ND renders the view from itemTitleKey and itemBodyKey, and every action runs through the same invocation broker with the same permission and grant checks. To extend this package, add a contribution that references an allowlisted ND host method and declare the permission that method requires.
